name: Well of Eternity extends Spectral Scythe by 10 sec (#3097)
contract: Spell 706793 (Well of Eternity) carries a native SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (SPELLMOD_DURATION) effect,
family 36, classmask 131072, matching Spectral Scythe's (500576) own SpellFamilyFlags[0] = 131072.
SPELLMOD_DURATION is applied generically by the core spell-duration path (Spell.cpp/SpellEffects.cpp
call ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_DURATION, duration)), so no CoA script is needed: learning the passive
talent alone should extend Spectral Scythe's duration by 10000 ms, matching the tooltip.

steps.label: SETUP: no duration modifier on Spectral Scythe before learning the talent
Well of Eternity adds a flat +10000 ms duration modifier to Spectral Scythe
Unlearning Well of Eternity removes the duration modifier
